mathematical_premises.claim: Every fixed rank-at-least-three target instance has an instance-dependent bounded density in C_0(R)
For every probability law, the supremum of Gaussian heat regularizations equals the bounded-density height; for C_0 densities Gaussian smoothing converges uniformly

new_result.statement: Let C_* be the supremum of s_3(A)||p_Q||_infinity over rank-at-least-three target instances. For every bounded nonnegative probability density K and any global maximizer y_* of the C_0 density p_Q, C_* equals the supremum of s_3(A) E K(Q-y_*).
consequences: Exact Gaussian unit-scale formulation centered at a true unsmoothed density mode
Exact tent formulation centered at y_*
Arbitrary-order positive punctured Gaussian kernels retain the same optimal constant
new_result.proof_mechanism: Upper bound by averaging p_Q against a probability kernel; lower bound by scalar matrix dilation A->lambda A and approximate-identity convergence at the continuous global maximum.

unresolved_implication: Prove a universal original-coordinate product-preserving small-ball/two-sheet/grouped-bank estimate at a true output-density maximizer; the peak-locked reduction itself does not bound the resulting functional.
continuity_ledger: Qualitative target-wide C_0 is used only to select a true maximizer and pass an approximate identity. No target-uniform regularity modulus is assumed or obtained. Universal L-infinity remains open.
next_step: Exploit y_* in argmax p_Q inside minority/two-sheet or grouped-bank geometry before any fiber supremum or reciprocal tiny-minor payment.
